title: Font glyph lookup
summary: Recover the 32-bit thiscall glyph lookup at 0x456e60, including line-break records, optional secondary-font search, and fallback.
test_description: Compare original and recovered lookup across primary and secondary matches, duplicate records, empty ranges, null secondary and output flag, missing and boundary character values, CR/LF, and an output flag aliased to a glyph byte. Compare returned addresses, flag canaries, font objects, records, and fallback storage.
known_limits: The layout and ABI describe the original 32-bit game; pointer-sized fields need adaptation for a 64-bit port.
Glyph contents and other font fields are opaque; malformed ranges and invalid pointers are not tested.
